name: B&B Hotel zur Schanz
beschreibung: The inn B&B Hotel zur Schanz is located in Ebbs in the Tiroler Unterland. The accommodation is conveniently situated near the border with Deutschland. The property offers guests comfortable rooms and a breakfast buffet. The garden restaurant invites you to linger when the weather is nice. The surrounding area is characterized by the Ebbser Moor and the Kaisergebirge. Hiking and cycling trails are easily accessible from the property. The inn is suitable both for short stays and for longer holidays. The hosts value personal attention and regional products.
